about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_delta.py). bad replays the diff-read miss: it throws the real miss line, or silently queries the wrong file. good runs the fixed query and prints the report it promises.

fixture.blame.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'zdiff3' in src and 'blame' in src and 'hyperlinks' in src
print('blame PASS conflict-blame-links')
fixture.feat.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'side-by-side' in src and 'line-numbers' in src and 'left-format' in src
print('feat PASS side-numbers-formats')
fixture.flags.txt:
delta is a syntax-highlighting pager for git diff and grep output plus blame.
Set pager = delta in [core] and diffFilter to delta --color-only.
Word-level highlight via Levenshtein edit inference between minus and plus lines.
side-by-side = true shows line-numbers on by default and wraps long lines.
Set navigate to true then n and N jump between diff sections and log -p views.
side-by-side enables line-numbers with line-numbers-left-format and left-format plus right-format columns.
Same themes as bat; delta --show-syntax-themes --dark lists the dark set.
Merge conflictStyle zdiff3; blame gains syntax highlighting plus --hyperlinks terminal links.
side-by-side navigate line-numbers syntax highlighting pager diffFilter left-format wraps
fixture.nav.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'navigate' in src and 'n and N' in src and 'diff sections' in src
print('nav PASS jump-between-diffs')
fixture.side.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'side-by-side = true' in src and 'line-numbers' in src and 'wraps' in src
print('side PASS two-panel-wraps')
fixture.theme.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'bat' in src and 'show-syntax-themes' in src and 'dark' in src
print('theme PASS bat-themes-dark')
fixture.what.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'syntax-highlighting pager' in src and 'git' in src and 'diff' in src and 'grep' in src
print('delta PASS pager-for-diffs')
fixture.wire.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'pager = delta' in src and 'diffFilter' in src and 'delta --color-only' in src
print('wire PASS pager-filter-wired')
fixture.word.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'Word-level' in src and 'Levenshtein' in src and 'edit inference' in src
print('word PASS word-level-edits')

pairs.bad: throw 'called delta a git replacement that rewrites history, missed syntax-highlighting pager for git diff grep'
throw 'scrolled by hand with no pager, missed pager = delta plus diffFilter delta --color-only'
throw 'could not see changed words, missed Word-level Levenshtein edit inference'
throw 'unified diff unreadable, missed side-by-side = true with line-numbers wraps'
throw 'paged 40 files by hand, missed navigate with n and N diff sections'
throw 'lost numbers in two panels, missed side-by-side line-numbers left-format'
throw 'read monochrome diffs at night, missed bat show-syntax-themes dark'
throw 'raw conflict markers and monochrome blame, missed zdiff3 blame hyperlinks'
rg -n "side-by-side" plain.txt; throw 'missed side-by-side: plain.txt carries no panel phrase'
rg -n "navigate" plain.txt; throw 'missed navigate: plain.txt carries no jump phrase'
rg -n "line-numbers" plain.txt; throw 'missed line-numbers: plain.txt carries no numbers phrase'
rg -n "syntax highlighting" plain.txt; throw 'missed syntax highlighting: plain.txt carries no styling phrase'
